items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, Calvin Jones, that’s where I met him.

ctx.x: Yeah, Calvin Jones, that’s where I met him. Then I came to a club called 2011 that was in the basement of the Dunbar hotel, with James Moody. I met this girl, and I lived here on Caroline Street between T and U.
Yeah, I got to find that street, that’s one I don’t know about. I have to research that one.
